title: News Shock & Recovery
briefing: A pipeline outage is about to send fuel prices flying, and airlines will take the hit. Momentum Max waits for the trend to prove itself. Do you buy the panic, the recovery, or nothing?
objective: After a shock, wait for evidence the damage is temporary, ride the recovery, and respect the next warning.
debrief: The pipeline outage on day 6 sent Kestrel Air down sharply, and early dip-buyers kept losing as fuel stayed high. The early repair on day 11 removed the cause and record summer bookings on day 16 extended the recovery. Then the pilots' union announced strike talks on day 24 and the gains started to slip away. A disciplined player waited for the repair news, rode the recovery with a stop and stepped aside when the strike threat appeared.
